conclusion: For the supplied inverted-triangle model, normal snug support produces a cleaner interface because SupportGridPattern trims contact geometry to actual overhang grid cells. Organic tree support additionally creates roof/contact stacks for future tree tips, expands the overhang footprint and joins components through shared reach and sharp-tip masks. At Z 5.4 the normal G-code has no support at all, while organic support emits a 58.534 mm closed interface loop spanning 21.543 mm. The long-loop problem is primarily contact-polygon generation and roof propagation, not the concentric filler itself.
